verdict.rationale: Together's serverless docs describe automatic prefix caching with no header, parameter, or toggle needed: resending the same prompt prefix bills any still-warm cached portion at a steeply discounted cached-input rate on select chat models. That clearly delivers the cost side of the story. missing for 10: evidence of latency reduction from cache hits, a list of supported models with the discount rate and cache lifetime, caching on dedicated endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
